name: kin_speed_resid_max
description: max |implied - reported speed| over pairs >= RATE_BASE_S apart
template: Position implies {aux_speed_implied_mps:.0f} m/s but the asset reports {aux_speed_reported_mps:.0f} m/s

name: kin_speed_resid_rel_max
description: max |implied - reported speed| / max(reported speed, COURSE_MIN_MPS)
template: Implied speed differs from reported speed by {v:.0%}

name: kin_speed_resid_mean
description: mean |implied - reported speed|: sustained mismatch, the smooth-drift signature
template: Implied and reported speed disagree by {v:.0f} m/s on average over 30 s

name: kin_speed_ratio_max
description: max(implied, reported speed) / class max speed (ground limit on ground, air limit airborne)
template: Speed is {v:.1f}x the maximum for a {aux_asset_class} ({aux_class_max_speed_mps:.0f} m/s)

name: kin_accel_ratio_max
description: max |change in reported speed| / dt / class max acceleration
template: Acceleration is {v:.1f}x the maximum for a {aux_asset_class}

name: kin_accel_imp_ratio_max
description: max |change in implied speed| / dt / class max acceleration
template: Position implies an acceleration {v:.1f}x the maximum for a {aux_asset_class}

name: kin_turn_rate_ratio_max
description: max |change in reported course| / dt / class max turn rate; moving only
template: Turn rate is {v:.1f}x the maximum for a {aux_asset_class}

name: kin_turn_rate_imp_ratio_max
description: max |change in implied course| / dt / class max turn rate; displacement >= COURSE_MIN_DISP_M
template: Position implies a turn rate {v:.1f}x the maximum for a {aux_asset_class}

name: kin_turn_radius_ratio_max
description: class min turn radius / observed radius (speed / turn rate); moving and turning only
template: Turn is {v:.1f}x tighter than a {aux_asset_class} can make

name: kin_vrate_ratio_max
description: max |reported vertical rate| / class max vertical rate
template: Vertical rate is {v:.1f}x the maximum for a {aux_asset_class}

name: kin_vrate_imp_ratio_max
description: max |change in altitude| / dt / class max vertical rate
template: Altitude changes {v:.1f}x faster than a {aux_asset_class} can climb or descend

name: kin_course_resid_max
description: max |implied course - reported course|; displacement >= COURSE_MIN_DISP_M
template: Direction of travel differs from reported course by {v:.0f} deg

name: kin_course_resid_mean
description: mean |implied course - reported course|
template: Direction of travel and reported course disagree by {v:.0f} deg on average

name: kin_heading_course_diff_max
description: max |heading - course over ground|; moving only
template: Heading and course differ by {v:.0f} deg

name: kin_pos_jitter_m
description: RMS residual of positions around a quadratic-in-time fit over the window
template: Position scatters {v:.0f} m around a smooth path

name: tmp_n_points
description: fixes in the window

name: tmp_gap_max_s
description: longest silence touching the window, including lead-in and time since the last fix
template: No position for {v:.0f} s

name: tmp_staleness_s
description: t_end minus the time of the last fix
template: Last position is {v:.0f} s old

name: tmp_dt_dev_ratio
description: |median dt in window - trailing baseline median dt| / baseline
template: Update interval changed by {v:.0%} from this track's usual rate

name: tmp_dup_count
description: fixes repeating an earlier timestamp
template: {v:.0f} repeated timestamps in 30 s

name: tmp_nonmono_count
description: fixes whose time is earlier than the previous fix in arrival (seq) order
template: {v:.0f} positions arrived out of order in 30 s

name: tmp_frozen_run_s
description: longest run of identical positions while reported speed > MOVING_MPS
template: Position frozen for {v:.0f} s while the asset reports movement

name: tmp_frozen_frac
description: share of fixes inside frozen runs
template: {v:.0%} of positions are frozen while the asset reports movement

name: sig_nacp_median
description: median NACp in the window
template: Reported position accuracy category is {v:.0f} (NACp)

name: sig_nacp_min
description: min NACp in the window
template: Reported position accuracy category fell to {v:.0f} (NACp)

name: sig_nacp_drop
description: trailing baseline median NACp minus window median, clipped at 0
template: Reported position accuracy dropped by {v:.0f} categories (NACp)

name: sig_nic_median
description: median NIC in the window
template: Reported integrity category is {v:.0f} (NIC)

name: sig_nic_drop
description: trailing baseline median NIC minus window median, clipped at 0
template: Reported integrity dropped by {v:.0f} categories (NIC)

name: sig_sil_min
description: min SIL in the window
template: Source integrity level fell to {v:.0f} (SIL)

name: sig_degraded_frac
description: share of fixes where is_degraded_reading() is true
template: {v:.0%} of positions in 30 s report degraded accuracy

name: sig_degraded_majority
description: 1 if sig_degraded_frac > 0.5 (majority rule)
template: Most positions in 30 s report degraded accuracy

name: sig_alt_div_dev_max_m
description: max |(GNSS alt - baro alt) - trailing baseline median of that difference|
template: GNSS altitude departs from barometric altitude by {v:.0f} m

name: sig_alt_div_rate_max
description: max |change in (GNSS alt - baro alt)| / dt over >= RATE_BASE_S
template: GNSS altitude drifts from barometric altitude at {v:.1f} m/s

name: spa_route_dist_max_m
description: max distance to the nearest authorized route for the asset domain
template: {v:.0f} m from the nearest authorized route

name: spa_route_dist_mean_m
description: mean distance to the nearest authorized route
template: {v:.0f} m from the nearest authorized route on average

name: spa_offzone_frac
description: share of ground fixes inside the airport boundary but in no zone polygon
template: {v:.0%} of positions are off every movement area

name: spa_in_building_frac
description: share of fixes inside a building footprint
template: {v:.0%} of positions fall inside a building

name: spa_off_airport
description: 1 if most ground fixes are outside the airport boundary
template: Ground asset reported outside the airport boundary

name: spa_zone_crit_max
description: max criticality of zones occupied or within ZONE_BUFFER_M; airborne: approach rule. Drives severity

name: ctx_zone_speed_ratio_max
description: max reported speed / zone speed limit
template: Speed is {v:.1f}x the {aux_zone_speed_limit_mps:.0f} m/s limit in {aux_zone_name}

name: ctx_type_violation_crit_max
description: max criticality of occupied zones where the asset class is not allowed (zone_access.csv); 0 if none
template: A {aux_asset_class} is not authorized in {aux_zone_name}

name: ctx_dwell_ratio
description: stationary time in the current zone / allowed dwell for (zone type, class)
template: Stationary {v:.1f}x longer than allowed in {aux_zone_name}

name: ctx_ground_alt_conflict
description: share of fixes where the on-ground flag contradicts height or speed
template: On-ground flag contradicts altitude or speed in {v:.0%} of positions

name: ctx_phase_conflict_frac
description: share of airborne fixes low (< 150 m above aerodrome) and > 500 m from any runway axis; helicopters skipped
template: Flying low away from any runway in {v:.0%} of positions

name: ctx_app_lateral_dev_deg
description: max angular offset from the extended runway centerline inside APPROACH_FINAL_KM
template: {v:.1f} deg off the runway centerline on final approach

name: ctx_app_glide_dev_deg
description: max |glide angle to threshold - GLIDESLOPE_DEG| inside APPROACH_FINAL_KM
template: {v:.1f} deg off the 3 deg glide path

name: ctx_app_descent_dev_ratio
description: mean |vertical rate - 3 deg descent rate| / 3 deg descent rate inside APPROACH_FINAL_KM
template: Descent rate differs from a 3 deg approach by {v:.0%}

name: ctx_identity_mismatch
description: identity rules fired on the RAW declared type: airline callsign on a light type; speed above the declared class
template: Declared aircraft type does not match callsign or performance

name: flt_n_others
description: other tracks in the cell and its k-ring, same time bin

name: flt_deg_rate_loo
description: degraded share among the OTHER tracks (leave-one-out)
template: {v:.0%} of other assets in this area are degraded at the same time

name: flt_deg_count_loo
description: number of OTHER degraded tracks
template: {v:.0f} other assets in this area are degraded at the same time

name: flt_cell_flagged_loo
description: 1 if the cell would be flagged without this track
template: Other assets in this area show degraded positions at the same time

name: flt_nbr_flagged_frac
description: share of ring-1 neighbor cells flagged, computed without this track
template: {v:.0%} of neighboring areas show degraded positions
